entry.title: Improving the Security of lArk OOR Channels with Equivocation Bonds
entry.summary: In the recent discussion, there was a focus on the security mechanisms for Out of Order (OOR) vtxos. The inquiry centered around whether these vtxos are inherently secured without the need to fund an OOR channel specifically. This question highlights an important aspect of transaction handling and security within certain systems, suggesting that OOR vtxos might possess inherent security features that negate the need for additional funding channels dedicated solely to their security. However, further clarification or detailed exploration into how these mechanisms are implemented or their efficacy would be beneficial for a comprehensive understanding.
